name: Rebekah Home for Girls
summary: Rebekah Home for Girls was a program in Corpus Christi, Texas, operated by Roloff Homes. It operated from 1967 to 2001.

links.label: Fornits: Lester Roloffs Rebekah Home for Girls Survivors-Cult-mindcon (2003-2015, 1260 posts). Former residents describe it as a cult-like facility run under Lester Roloff's ministry where girls faced extreme isolation, restraints, and forced scripture memorization, while defenders credit the home with saving their lives and providing Christian guidance.

news.title: The History of Lester Roloff's Faith-Based Youth Homes and State Oversight Battles
news.summary: The article documents the history of the Rebekah Home for Girls, a faith‑based residential facility founded by evangelist Lester Roloff, and describes disciplinary practices such as corporal punishment, isolation, and restraints. It includes survivor accounts of physical and spiritual abuse and outlines the facility’s legal battles over state licensing and oversight.

news.title: ALL IN THE NAME OF GOD: THE MULTIBILLION DOLLAR TROUBLED TEEN INDUSTRY AND THE CHRISTIANS WHO PROFIT FROM IT (2022-03-21)
news.summary: The article reports on allegations of physical, spiritual, and sexual abuse in several faith‑based residential programs for troubled teens. It cites survivor testimonies describing forced silence, beatings, and conversion therapy practices. The piece highlights legal challenges that have allowed some facilities to operate with limited oversight.
